author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + Quadratic Head Calibration (QHC) for regression-family tasks — seed=42
abstract: Augment regression-family heads with a minimal quadratic term after RegCal: concat[z, α·z^2] before the final Dense. Captures simple second-order effects without loop changes; classification heads unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from hdp_regcal_quad_head import create_network, create_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "head_hidden_reg": 128,
        "head_hidden_cls": 128,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "regcal_on": True,
        "motif_k": 5,
        "quad_alpha_init": 0.2,
    }
